questionText:
Consider the following sequence of operations on an empty stack.

$$\text{push}(54); \text{push}(52); \text{pop}(); \text{push}(55); \text{push}(62); s = \text{pop}();$$

Consider the following sequence of operations on an empty queue.

$$\text{enqueue}(21); \text{enqueue}(24); \text{dequeue}(); \text{enqueue}(28); \text{enqueue}(32); q = \text{dequeue}();$$

The value of $s + q$ is ________.
explanation:
Step 1: Trace Stack Operations (LIFO - Last In First Out)
- $\text{push}(54) \rightarrow$ Stack: $[54]$
- $\text{push}(52) \rightarrow$ Stack: $[54, 52]$
- $\text{pop}() \rightarrow$ Stack: $[54]$ (removes $52$)
- $\text{push}(55) \rightarrow$ Stack: $[54, 55]$
- $\text{push}(62) \rightarrow$ Stack: $[54, 55, 62]$
- $s = \text{pop}() \rightarrow$ Pops the top element $62$, so $s = 62$.

Step 2: Trace Queue Operations (FIFO - First In First Out)
- $\text{enqueue}(21) \rightarrow$ Queue: $[21]$
- $\text{enqueue}(24) \rightarrow$ Queue: $[21, 24]$
- $\text{dequeue}() \rightarrow$ Queue: $[24]$ (removes $21$)
- $\text{enqueue}(28) \rightarrow$ Queue: $[24, 28]$
- $\text{enqueue}(32) \rightarrow$ Queue: $[24, 28, 32]$
- $q = \text{dequeue}() \rightarrow$ Removes the front element $24$, so $q = 24$.

Step 3: Calculate $s + q$
$s + q = 62 + 24 = 86$.
